zodiac_page.desc_aries: Bold, direct, and ready to lead new beginnings with confidence.
zodiac_page.desc_taurus: Grounded, loyal, and drawn to comfort, stability, and lasting value.
zodiac_page.desc_gemini: Curious, witty, and most alive when learning, sharing, and connecting.
zodiac_page.desc_cancer: Emotional, intuitive, and naturally protective of the people they love.
zodiac_page.desc_leo: Warm, creative, and inspiring when they feel free to shine.
zodiac_page.desc_virgo: Detail-oriented, helpful, and focused on making life more organized.
zodiac_page.desc_libra: Balanced, graceful, and guided by harmony, fairness, and connection.
zodiac_page.desc_scorpio: Deep, intense, and strengthened by transformation and emotional truth.
zodiac_page.desc_sagittarius: Free-spirited, optimistic, and always seeking meaning through experience.
zodiac_page.desc_capricorn: Disciplined, patient, and willing to build success step by step.
zodiac_page.desc_aquarius: Original, independent, and drawn to new ideas and future possibilities.
zodiac_page.desc_pisces: Intuitive, compassionate, and guided by imagination and emotional depth.
zodiac_page.major_arcana_message_aries: The Emperor combines Aries courage with direction, discipline, and leadership.
zodiac_page.major_arcana_message_taurus: The Hierophant speaks to Taurus values, loyalty, and the building of lasting order.
zodiac_page.major_arcana_message_gemini: The Lovers carries Gemini’s theme of choice, communication, and harmonizing two ideas.
zodiac_page.major_arcana_message_cancer: The Chariot shows Cancer’s strength in keeping direction through emotional waves.
zodiac_page.major_arcana_message_leo: Strength represents Leo’s heartfelt courage and warm leadership.
zodiac_page.major_arcana_message_virgo: The Hermit describes Virgo’s guiding side that seeks wisdom inside the details.
zodiac_page.major_arcana_message_libra: Justice highlights Libra’s lesson of balance, fairness, and clear decisions in relationships.
zodiac_page.major_arcana_message_scorpio: Death carries Scorpio’s theme of transformation, release, and being reborn stronger.
zodiac_page.major_arcana_message_sagittarius: Temperance opens Sagittarius to blend experiences and find broader meaning.
zodiac_page.major_arcana_message_capricorn: The Devil shows Capricorn’s conscious relationship with ambition, boundaries, and attachment.
zodiac_page.major_arcana_message_aquarius: The Star describes Aquarius vision, hope, and original light facing the future.
zodiac_page.major_arcana_message_pisces: The Moon represents Pisces listening for truth through intuition, dreams, and uncertainty.
zodiac_page.energy_focus_fire: Grows through quick decisions, courage, and visible action; it opens through movement.
zodiac_page.energy_focus_earth: Needs tangible results, trust, and rhythm; steady effort brings it into its strongest form.
zodiac_page.energy_focus_air: Shines through ideas, connection, and communication; mental flexibility is the main resource.
zodiac_page.energy_focus_water: Deepens through emotion, intuition, and bonding; it becomes clearer by listening within.
zodiac_page.growth_key_cardinal: To combine initiating power with patience and learn not to carry everything alone.
zodiac_page.growth_key_fixed: To preserve stability while making room for change and softening control a little.
zodiac_page.growth_key_mutable: To combine adaptability with focus and direct energy without scattering it.
zodiac_page.daily_intention_aries: Today I place my courage in a conscious direction.
zodiac_page.daily_intention_taurus: Today I patiently grow the choices that give me trust.
zodiac_page.daily_intention_gemini: Today I turn my curiosity into clear expression.
zodiac_page.daily_intention_cancer: Today I listen to my feelings and make space for myself.
zodiac_page.daily_intention_leo: Today I share my light generously and authentically.
zodiac_page.daily_intention_virgo: Today I build greater order through small details.

zodiac_page.daily_intention_capricorn: Today I approach my goal calmly and with discipline.
zodiac_page.daily_intention_aquarius: Today I trust my original idea and make space for the future.
zodiac_page.daily_intention_pisces: Today I listen to my intuition and keep my heart soft.

compat_page.title: Compatibility
compat_page.tone_desc_0: Core expectations are pulling in different directions. Clear boundaries and patience matter here.
compat_page.tone_desc_1: Attraction may not be enough on its own. Trust and communication need conscious work.
compat_page.tone_desc_2: There is curiosity between you, but misunderstandings can tire the bond quickly.
compat_page.tone_desc_3: This connection highlights sensitive spots. Balance can grow, but it needs care.
compat_page.tone_desc_4: Some parts flow while others create friction. Honest conversations can improve the match.
compat_page.tone_desc_5: There is common ground here. The right pace and mutual understanding can strengthen it.
compat_page.tone_desc_6: The harmony is starting to show. Managing small differences can deepen the connection.
compat_page.tone_desc_7: You support each other in many areas. Open communication can make this bond steadier.
compat_page.tone_desc_8: The attraction between you looks strong. Emotional openness can make the relationship even richer.
compat_page.tone_desc_9: The rhythm between you feels natural and strong. With care, this can become lasting harmony.
compat_page.summary_tone_mid: a connection with potential that needs pacing
compat_page.summary_tone_low: a challenging bond with both attraction and sensitivity
compat_page.summary_tone_very_low: a revealing bond that makes different expectations visible
compat_page.summary_element_same: The same element makes the basic rhythm feel familiar quickly.
compat_page.summary_element_compatible: The elements feed each other, creating a natural flow.
compat_page.summary_element_neutral: The elements bring different needs to the same table.
compat_page.summary_element_tense: The elements move at different speeds, so the bond asks for effort.
compat_page.summary_aspect_supportive: A supportive aspect increases communication and curiosity.
compat_page.summary_aspect_square: The square aspect can touch sensitive points quickly.
compat_page.summary_aspect_trine: The trine aspect makes harmony feel natural and warm.
compat_page.summary_aspect_adjust: Small adjustments and patience help the match.
compat_page.summary_aspect_opposite: Opposition brings both attraction and a lesson in balance.
compat_page.summary_aspect_mixed: The aspect gives the relationship a mixed but revealing tempo.
compat_page.summary_balance_template: For this relationship to work well, {aNeed} and {bNeed} both need room.
compat_page.summary_gender_female_male: {a} tends to read the bond more intuitively, while {b} is more likely to show emotion through behavior.
compat_page.summary_gender_male_female: {a} tends to move more directly, while {b} measures emotional safety first.
compat_page.role_female_aries: An Aries woman wants clarity, pace, and bold effort in love.
compat_page.role_female_taurus: A Taurus woman softens through trust, loyalty, and visible care.
compat_page.role_female_gemini: A Gemini woman looks for mental spark and flexible communication.
compat_page.role_female_cancer: A Cancer woman looks for emotional safety and a feeling of being held.
compat_page.role_female_leo: A Leo woman expects visible attention, appreciation, and warmth.
compat_page.role_female_virgo: A Virgo woman watches consistency, care, and clear behavior.
compat_page.role_female_libra: A Libra woman wants respectful communication and mutual grace.
compat_page.role_female_scorpio: A Scorpio woman looks for depth, honesty, and emotional courage.
compat_page.role_female_sagittarius: A Sagittarius woman wants freedom, joy, and direct honesty.
compat_page.role_female_capricorn: A Capricorn woman looks for seriousness, responsibility, and a reliable pace.
compat_page.role_female_aquarius: An Aquarius woman wants individuality, friendship, and mental freedom.
compat_page.role_female_pisces: A Pisces woman opens through kindness, empathy, and gentle closeness.
compat_page.role_male_aries: An Aries man tends to live love directly, quickly, and clearly.
compat_page.role_male_taurus: A Taurus man builds trust through behavior and wants steadiness.
compat_page.role_male_gemini: A Gemini man gets close through conversation and tires of stagnation.
compat_page.role_male_cancer: A Cancer man does not open easily without safety, but becomes protective when attached.
compat_page.role_male_leo: A Leo man wants to clearly see that he is loved and appreciated.
compat_page.role_male_virgo: A Virgo man shows love through order, attention, and practical care.
compat_page.role_male_libra: A Libra man looks for harmony, kindness, and fair communication.
compat_page.role_male_scorpio: A Scorpio man bonds intensely and becomes uneasy with superficiality.
compat_page.role_male_sagittarius: A Sagittarius man gets close through freedom, humor, and relaxed communication.
compat_page.role_male_capricorn: A Capricorn man measures love through seriousness, effort, and long-term intent.
compat_page.role_male_aquarius: An Aquarius man wants friendship and mental compatibility first.
compat_page.role_male_pisces: A Pisces man opens when he sees emotional gentleness and understanding.
